# Análisis de diseño experimental

## Base de datos

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=1263018298#gid=1263018298

## Indentificar los factores

1. Factor 1: genotipo
1. Factor 2: riego

## Identificar el modelo

Factorial en DBCA

$$y = \mu + bloque + G + I + G*I + \xi$$

# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15r7ZwcZZHbEgltlF6gSFvCTFA-CFzVBWwg3mFlRyKPs/edit?gid=172957346#gid=172957346" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:4), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()
```

# Análisis de variancia

```{r}
# aov() ó lm()

md <- aov(lfa ~ block + irrigation + genotype + irrigation * genotype, fb)

anova(md)
```

# Comparación de médias

```{r}
mc <- emmeans(md, ~ genotype * irrigation)

# Letras de significancia
tab <- cld(mc, 
              adjust = "sidak",
              Letters = letters
           , decreasing = T)

tab
```

# Representación gráfica

```{r}
pl <- plot_smr(data = tab
               , x = "genotype"
               , y = "emmean"
               , group = "irrigation"
               , error = "SE"
               , sig = ".group"
               , ylab = "Área foliar (cm2)"
               )

pl
```
